_note: OFFICIAL go-live values (docs/MAINNET-RUNBOOK.md 'Go-live (single key, today)'; scripts/mainnet/golive.ts). Public values only. Owner decisions 2026-10-12: no multisig today, the dev wallet is admin, upgrade authority and every wallet-configurable recipient; fee split 70% compute, 30% protocol. Every key under a block named `owner_decision` is a TEST value carried over or a PROPOSAL of the go-live prep lane: the owner confirms or edits it before `golive.ts init --send` (init refuses while `owner_confirmed` is false). Token amounts are whole $UNITS (6 decimals, pump.fun supply 1,000,000,000). Amounts ending in _usd are US dollars and are turned into $UNITS at the price read from $UNITS's own pump.fun market (its curve or pool, times SOL/USD from Jupiter) at the moment `init` first resolves them; the resolution is written to <out>/official-resolved.json and reused on every resume.

site._verifiers_note: The site's own three (reference runner: burn only; v1, v2: burn and bond) are registered by `instance.sh chain` with keys that live on the server. extra_verifiers live on the capacity server; the owner key signs their register and bond, the box co-signs the register.

owner_decision._scale_note: The registry token amounts below are the TEST values times 200,000 (one choice: a verifier's minimum bond is 0.1% of the supply instead of 5 tokens). Change the scale by editing the amounts; the ratios between them are the TEST ones.
owner_decision._epoch_note: Core's epoch is 900 s (owner 2026-10-12: results on chain every 15 minutes). Re-scaled for it, as PROPOSALS: max_slash_bps_per_epoch 2500 (the cap's window is one posted epoch, now 15 minutes instead of a day; 2500 is the lowest the program allows, the largest single slash share) and max_rebate_per_epoch 500,000 (Core does not check the cap before posting and an epoch over it blocks every later post; 500,000 is 2,500 class-units of replays in 15 minutes). core_authority_target_sol: pre tops the Core authority hot key up to this from the dev wallet (96 posts a day at 0.001493440 SOL is 0.143370240 SOL a day).

bond._note: What `golive.ts bond` does with the dev wallet: uses the $UNITS it already holds, buys only the shortfall on $UNITS's curve (exact amount out, at most the quote plus slippage_bps), and sends the site's verifier owner key the $UNITS for every burn and bond plus owner_sol for its fees and the agent records' rent.
